title: Meta Launches AI Coding Agent Muse Code to Compete with OpenAI and Anthropic
description: Meta has introduced Muse Code, an AI coding agent, as it aims to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI coding space.

sources.title: Meta debuts first AI coding agent to take on Anthropic and OpenAI
Meta releases AI coding agent Muse Code as it looks to take on OpenAI, Anthropic (META:NASDAQ)
Meta makes AI Developer Assistant its primary support option

sections.heading: Muse Code Introduction
paragraphs: Meta has debuted its first AI coding agent, Muse Code, marking its entry into the AI coding market to take on competitors like Anthropic and OpenAI, according to CNBC.

sections.heading: Competition in AI Coding
paragraphs: The launch of Muse Code positions Meta to compete directly with established players in the AI coding industry, such as OpenAI and Anthropic, as Seeking Alpha reports.

sections.heading: AI Developer Assistant
paragraphs: In addition to Muse Code, Meta has made AI Developer Assistant its primary support option, as stated by Social Media Today.

faq.a: Muse Code is Meta's newly launched AI coding agent designed to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic.

faq.q: Why is Meta launching Muse Code?
faq.a: Meta is launching Muse Code to enter the AI coding market and compete with existing players like OpenAI and Anthropic.
